schema:
CREATE TABLE comments (
  CreationDate,
  Id,
  PostId,
  Score,
  Text,
  UserDisplayName,
  UserId
);

CREATE TABLE postHistory (
  Comment,
  CreationDate,
  Id,
  PostHistoryTypeId,
  PostId,
  RevisionGUID,
  Text,
  UserDisplayName,
  UserId
);

CREATE TABLE postLinks (
  CreationDate,
  Id,
  LinkTypeId,
  PostId,
  RelatedPostId
);

CREATE TABLE posts (
  AcceptedAnswerId,
  AnswerCount,
  Body,
  ClosedDate,
  CommentCount,
  CommunityOwnedDate,
  CreaionDate,
  FavoriteCount,
  Id,
  LasActivityDate,
  LastEditDate,
  LastEditorDisplayName,
  LastEditorUserId,
  OwnerDisplayName,
  OwnerUserId,
  ParentId,
  PostTypeId,
  Score,
  Tags,
  Title,
  ViewCount
);

CREATE TABLE tags (
  Count,
  ExcerptPostId,
  Id,
  TagName,
  WikiPostId
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  AboutMe,
  AccountId,
  Age,
  CreationDate,
  DisplayName,
  DownVotes,
  Id,
  LastAccessDate,
  Location,
  ProfileImageUrl,
  Reputation,
  UpVotes,
  Views,
  WebsiteUrl
);

CREATE TABLE votes (
  BountyAmount,
  CreationDate,
  Id,
  PostId,
  UserId,
  VoteTypeId
);
